# Changelog ## 0.1.227

This update brings the reactor tablet: watch your whole reactor from 64 blocks away through an antenna in its wall. ### New - **Reinforced Glass Trapdoor.** A steel frame round a see-through glass pane that opens by hand or by redstone, as tough as Reinforced Glass. - Your first dose of radiation earns the "Invisible Dose" advancement: its toast explains the radiation icon and points you to the Geiger counter. It shows once and is not announced in chat. - **Reactor antenna and tablet.** An antenna set into the reactor room's wall sends the reactor's screen to a tablet within 64 blocks, view only. Without a signal the tablet shows interference and why. - **The reactor tablet in your hands.** Both hands lift it and its screen unfolds to almost fill the view. Its lamps glow red while the reactor is in danger, even in the hotbar, and it shows its charge.

releases.notes:
# Changelog ## 0.1.224

Honey arrives: a new centrifuge spins combs into liquid honey that flows through your pipes, plus a radiation icon and fixes. ### New - **Liquid honey.** A honey bucket and a thick amber pool that spreads as slowly as lava and holds you like a cobweb. It runs through pipes and tanks and carries the `c:honey` tag. - **Honey Centrifuge.** An LV machine that spins honeycombs, honey bottles and honey blocks into liquid honey, filling a bucket or a pipe. The Polymerizer now turns 1000 mB of honey into a honey block. ### Improved - The mod's description in the mod list is up to date: it now tells what the mod has today, in every language the mod speaks, and in some builds of the mod the mod list now shows it translated. - Simplified Chinese names of the pump, the electric shovel and the four diamond-tipped tools now follow the game's own wording everywhere. ### Bug Fixes - Radiation now shows its effect icon in the HUD, so you can tell you are irradiated before you have a Geiger counter. The level and the time left are in the inventory screen; the player still gets no particles. - The mob wheel no longer sits at 0 EU/t while its runner is running: it always gives at least 1 EU/t.
